name: Mollie
label: Mollie — Mollie API v2
description: Official Mollie API v2. Docs: https://docs.mollie.com/reference/overview. One node; operations via `operation`. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets. EEA PSP. Redirect / Mollie Components — never PAN. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Mollie. Secrets never on this port. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: payment_create | payment_get | refund_create | customer_create | mandate_create | trigger. trigger (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: Id
schema.description: Mollie payment id for payment_get / refund_create. Example: tr_WDqYK6vllg.

schema.label: amount
schema.description: Mollie Amount object {currency, value} for payment_create and refund_create. Example: {"currency":"EUR","value":"10.00"}. Never send card PAN.

schema.label: description
schema.description: payment_create description shown to the customer. Example: Order #1042.

schema.label: redirectUrl
schema.description: payment_create URL the customer is sent to after payment. HTTPS. Example: https://shop.example/orders/1042.

schema.label: webhookUrl
schema.description: payment_create webhook URL Mollie calls with the payment id. HTTPS.

schema.label: method
schema.description: payment_create payment method (ideal, creditcard, …) or mandate_create method (directdebit). Example: ideal.

schema.label: name
schema.description: customer_create full name. Example: Ada Lovelace.

schema.label: customerId
schema.description: Mollie customer id for mandate_create. Example: cst_8wmqcHMN4U.

schema.label: consumerName
schema.description: mandate_create account holder name. Example: Ada Lovelace.

schema.label: consumerAccount
schema.description: mandate_create IBAN (directdebit). Never log. Example: NL55INGB0000000000.

schema.label: consumerBic
schema.description: mandate_create BIC when required. Example: INGBNL2A.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: payment_create | payment_get | refund_create | customer_create | mandate_create | trigger. Default payment_create. Selecting trigger (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Mollie credential (bearer Authorization). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
